summary_text: Of 56 total findings released this period, 11 touch goals in Financial Stability Board's remit. Goals in remit: market_integrity, settlement, custody, transaction_integrity. The findings span the harness sources: GSPC axis 18: economic-behavior (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 12: swarm, GSPC axis 10: detector-interop, GSPC axis 14: jail, GSPC axis 23: effect-binding (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 19: collusion (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 20: deception (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 15: memory-poisoning (REGISTERING, adapter defined).

outreach_pack.cover_letter:
Dear Financial Stability Board,

This is a permissionless, openly-licensed measurement crosswalk for the period September 2026. Every figure is reproducible from the linked artifacts; every linked artifact carries a sha256 and an OpenTimestamps stamp. The CSOAI substrate does not certify, accredit, or rate — it measures, signs, and records. Please treat this as raw observation; we welcome challenge on method, scope, and conclusion.

Best,
Nicholas Templeman
Founder, CSOAI
outreach_pack.submission_recommendation: Open public-comment period / consultation response / evidence submission as appropriate for the regulator's process.
